label: Making Plans
description: Inviting, suggesting, agreeing on a time, and arranging to meet up.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: asking if someone is free. The phrase opens an invitation by checking availability. Свободен is the masculine short-form adjective for free, and сегодня вечером means this evening.
Strategic focus: suggesting an activity. Давай introduces a friendly proposal, while сходим is the perfective we-form for going somewhere and back. В кино names the cinema as the destination.
Strategic focus: extending an invitation. Приглашаю is the first-person present of приглашать, to invite. Тебя is the accusative of ты, and в кафе marks the café as the place.
Strategic focus: agreeing on a time. The question asks when a meeting suits the other person. Удобно means convenient, and встретиться is the reflexive infinitive to meet up.

missions.phrase: Давай встретимся у входа в семь.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: setting a place and time. Встретимся is the we-form for we will meet, у входа means by the entrance, and в семь spells out the hour seven.
Strategic focus: a polite yes-no question. The particle ли makes the question formal and tidy. Свободна is the feminine short form for free, and в субботу means on Saturday.
Strategic focus: agreeing to a plan. Согласен is the masculine short form meaning I agree. Пойдём is the we-form let us go, and гулять is the infinitive to take a walk.
Strategic focus: politely declining. Извини softens the refusal with an apology. Занят is the masculine short form for busy, explaining why today does not work.
Strategic focus: pinning down the time. Во сколько asks at what hour, and завтра means tomorrow. Удобно again checks what is convenient for the other person.
Strategic focus: confirming the arrangement. Отлично signals enthusiastic agreement. До встречи is a farewell meaning until we meet, and вечером fixes the plan for the evening.
